local_models.description: Local model execution, local inference behavior, local model UX, local-only fallback, and local hardware constraints.

local_model_providers.description: Local or self-hosted model backend setup, discovery, auth, routing, and compatibility only; not hosted provider catalogs or provider manifests.

model_serving.description: Serving protocols, streaming behavior, routing, lifecycle, and gateway behavior for model endpoints.

self_hosted_inference.description: Self-hosted inference systems and locally operated services, including embeddings, speech, and memory providers.

open_weight_models.description: Open-weight model families, model packaging, quantization, and local deployability signals.

acpx.description: ACPX protocol, transport, proxy, backend process, compatibility, and files or commands explicitly named ACPX.

acp.description: ACP protocol features and session tools that are not necessarily ACPX-specific.

coding_agents.description: General coding-agent runtime, tools, approvals, sandboxes, sessions, hooks, and orchestration.

mcp_tooling.description: MCP server or client behavior, tools/list, resources, and tool invocation compatibility.

hf_agents.description: Hugging Face agent workflows, Spaces, Hub agent demos, or HF-specific agent integrations.

hub_workflows.description: Hub automation for datasets, models, Spaces, releases, and repository synchronization.

post_training.description: Fine-tuning, preference optimization, evaluation loops, and data generation after pretraining.

model_releases.description: New model release tracking or version-specific model behavior.

agent_demos.description: Demo workflows and visible examples for agents.

codex.description: Items that explicitly involve the Codex runtime or command compatibility.

agent_runtime.description: Agent runner, harness, orchestration, subagent execution, heartbeat, and agent lifecycle behavior.

sessions.description: Session identity, persistence, binding, transcript, resume, reset, parent/child session behavior, and session stores.

gateway.description: OpenClaw gateway behavior, daemon startup, HTTP gateway routes, gateway restart, gateway state, and service health.

exec_tools.description: Shell execution, exec tools, command allowlists, tool invocation, tool schemas, and durable process handling.

approvals.description: Approval flows, permission modes, approve/deny commands, policy checks, and pending approval state.

sandboxing.description: Sandbox isolation, containers, Docker, process limits, filesystem hiding, and execution boundaries.

hooks.description: Hook lifecycle, hook events, hook payloads, hook filtering, and managed hook behavior.

cron_automation.description: Cron jobs, scheduled runs, heartbeat automation, one-shot jobs, and recurring task execution.

chat_integrations.description: Chat platform integrations and delivery surfaces such as Discord, Telegram, Slack, Feishu, WhatsApp, Zulip, Mattermost, and webchat.

ui_tui.description: Control UI, TUI, dashboard, web UI, session list, status views, and user-facing interface changes.

browser_automation.description: Browser automation, screenshots, Chrome integration, browser vision, and web interaction tooling.

memory.description: Memory systems, embeddings, vector stores, active memory, LanceDB, and memory archival or recovery.

security.description: Security, SSRF, credentials, secrets, token handling, auth hardening, HMAC, vulnerabilities, and unsafe access prevention.

config.description: Configuration files, config schema, defaults, setup/onboarding, environment variables, overrides, and migration.

packaging_deployment.description: Build, packaging, deployment, service managers, SEA, launchd, systemd, pnpm, and runtime distribution.

docs.description: Documentation, guides, README changes, spelling, taxonomy, and explanatory content.

tests_ci.description: Tests, CI, fixtures, coverage, mocks, and platform-specific test fixes.

telemetry_usage.description: Usage accounting, token counts, cost metadata, traces, diagnostics, status reporting, and observability.

api_surface.description: HTTP APIs, gateway APIs, REST endpoints, webhooks, SSE, OpenResponses, chat completions, and request/response contracts.

queueing.description: Queues, lanes, task state, follow-up queues, run ordering, locks, stuck jobs, and backpressure.

notifications.description: Notification policy, delivery gates, notify settings, outbound messages, announcements, and sent-message handling.

skills_plugins.description: Skills, plugins, plugin runtime, extensions, Superpowers, hook packs, MCP Apps, and plugin approvals.

auth_identity.description: Authentication, identity, OAuth, device identity, profile selection, account binding, token-only auth, and credential scope.

reliability.description: Reliability fixes for retries, stale state, crashes, timeouts, recovery, cleanup, race conditions, and wedged processes.

tool_calling.description: Model tool-calling behavior, tool-call deltas, tool schemas, tool result routing, and tool-use compatibility.
